name: com.laboon.mobile-firebase
description: Optional template only. Samples for wiring a project-local Firebase SDK into the kit: crash reporter adapter, IMobileBuildHook for Gradle/SwiftPM resources, and the SDK resource copy script. Contains no compiled code and no Firebase dependency.

samples.description: FirebaseCrashReporter (ICrashReporter), FirebaseBuildHook (IMobileBuildHook) and copy_ios_sdk_resources.sh. Import into a project that already has the Firebase Unity SDK.
